as it is said: 'for the poor shall not cease from the midst of the land' (Deut 15:11)
R' Yochanan: all the prophets prophesied only for penitents
but the fully righteous -- 'no eye has seen, God, aside from You'

what is 'far'? one who was far from a matter of transgression from the outset

...over which no creature's eye has ruled

the Garden is one thing and Eden another
the verse says: 'and a river went out of Eden to water the Garden' (Gen 2:10)
